create_Trainer: create a Trainer instance with modules, environment, and params to manage symbolic mathematics model training
run_enc_dec_step: run an encoding/decoding training step for a given task using encoder and decoder modules
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optional optimizer state to a specified path for later reloading
reload_checkpoint: reload a previously saved checkpoint to resume training from a specific epoch and iteration
optimize_loss: optimize the model by performing backward pass with gradient clipping and AMP support
